description: A ground-level photograph capturing a vast, flat, and arid landscape under a clear, bright blue sky. The ground is uniformly covered by a white, textured, and cracked layer, characteristic of precipitated salt, suggesting either a salt flat or a dried-up wetland. A thin, dark horizontal line demarcates the distant horizon, indicating sparse or no vegetation in the immediate foreground. In the bottom left corner, the attribution "© European Union, 2012" and "LUCAS" is visible, identifying the image as originating from the Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey. This visual evidence of bare soil resulting from the previous presence of water is relevant for land cover classification within wetland categories.
